items.title: Saudi-led coalition strikes oil site in Yemen's capital
items.description:
Yemen’s Houthis said Saudi Arabia struck an oil facility in Sanaa on Tuesday, after the Riyadh-led coalition told civilians to leave the surrounding area in its first evacuation order for the Yemeni capital since the war flared up again.
The Saudi-led coalition said military operations were conducted against “vital assets” used by the Houthis to wage war in Yemen.

items.title: 5 killed, several injured as Peshawar-bound train derails in Punjab's Multan district
items.description:

items.description:

items.title: Pakistan’s growth during FY27 projected at 3.5pc, inflation at 9.9pc: IMF
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has projected Pakistan’s economic growth at 3.5 per cent during the current fiscal year and inflation to remain close to double digits for another year, notwithstanding global growth rebounding to 3.4pc.
In its flagship World Economic Outlook, released at the launch of the World Bank-IMF annual meetings in Bangkok, the fund estimated Pakistan’s current account deficit to widen to 1pc of GDP from a surplus of 0.5pc in FY2025. items.title: Pakistan condemns Israeli actions in Syria, calls for withdrawal
items.description:
UNITED NATIONS: Pakistan has condemned continued Israeli military actions in Syria, calling for Israel’s withdrawal from all occupied Syrian territory and full respect for the 1974 Disengagement of Forces Agreement.
Speaking at a UN Security Council briefing on the humanitarian and political situation in Syria on Monday evening, Pakistan’s Acting Permanent Representative, Ambassador Usman Jadoon, said Israeli actions violated international law and Syria’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, undermining prospects for regional peace and stability.
